reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text: The paid version does not have all the emojis you get in the free version. There are less than half and you don’t get all the categories you have in the free version. It’s a total ripoff. A lot of the time the app just crashes and doesn’t work properly. Not a fan! If you got everything from the free version, that would be worth it!
